han.title: Simulated HAN
han.description: The HAN reports the power of the whole house: the background power plus the power of every simulated device.

data_description.background_w: Consumption not covered by the simulated devices. It can be changed while Home Assistant runs.

heater.title: Simulated heating device
heater.description: The device heats in a fixed cycle while its switch is on: first on for the duty cycle's share of the period, then off. The cycle starts again each time the switch is turned on or the cycle is changed.

data_description.duty_cycle_pct: Share of the period the device heats.
data_description.period_min: Length of one cycle in minutes.

thermostat.title: Simulated thermostat
thermostat.description: A heating device controlled by a thermostat with the chosen HVAC modes. In heat, heat/cool and auto it heats in a fixed cycle while the target temperature is above the room temperature: first on for the duty cycle's share of the period, then off. The other modes use nothing. The cycle starts again each time it starts heating, and when the cycle is changed. Turning it on returns it to the last heating mode.

data_description.duty_cycle_pct: Share of the period the device heats.
data_description.period_min: Length of one cycle in minutes.
data_description.hvac_modes: At least one heating mode: heat, heat/cool or auto.
data_description.room_temperature: The temperature in the room. It does not change by itself, but can be changed while Home Assistant runs.

charger.title: Simulated EV charger
charger.description: A 400 V three-phase charger. It draws √3 × 400 V × the charging current while charging is allowed, a car is connected and the car is not fully charged.

error.max_below_min: The maximum current must be at least the minimum current.
error.no_heating_mode: Choose at least one heating mode: heat, heat/cool or auto.

abort.single_han: There is already a simulated HAN.
